daemon.reason: A persistent daemon was not added. The pre-optimization profile showed the hit-path record rewrite near 3.1 ms and record decode near 0.75 ms. Guard checks and CAS restore stay on the hit path because they are the safety check. A warm process would not remove those costs, so the daemon is not worth its protocol and lifecycle.
